factual_methodology.summary: Treasury official 7/8 October par curve, EIA forecasts published 6 October with 1 October inputs, ECB September meeting account, B3 8 October close, and IBGE/BLS release calendars checked. Scheduled September IPCA and 9 October market closes are deliberately not asserted.

novelty.summary: Compared with the 8 October auction analysis, 9 October prioritises EIA's medium-term forecast revision, European energy inflation transmission, and the forthcoming Brazilian inflation print.

editorial_publication_readiness.summary: Distinct morning cutoff, observation-versus-forecast separation, alternative conditional scenarios, country-level distributional mechanisms, source links and no investment advice.

contextual_depth.summary: Distinguishes crude from fuel costs; sovereign duration from private investment financing; energy exporters from consumers; and announced data releases from published observations.

visual_evidence_readiness.signature: 1 evidence table + 2 same-unit quantitative charts + 1 causal flow + 1 regional map, in both EN and PT-BR
visual_evidence_readiness.summary: EIA four values match sourced September/October forecast comparison in USD/bbl; Treasury six yields match 7/8 Oct official percent figures. All visuals and caveats correspond in both languages.
visual_evidence_readiness.limitations: EIA inputs were finalized before 8 October oil volatility, ECB forecasts from the September policy account; the IPCA had not been incorporated at the information cutoff.

contrary_evidence: A subsequent decline in refined energy costs or inventories easing would weaken the persistent-cost scenario.
Later revised EIA forecasts may not sustain the raised 2027 Brent outlook.
limitations: Morning edition is based on 8 October U.S./Brazil closing data, not an intra-day price feed.
Brazil September IPCA is scheduled for 9 October and explicitly excluded until published.
EIA October STEO inputs predate the latest oil market movement.
notes: EN/PT-BR reviewed for same observed values, projection status, research visuals, chronology, and conditional claims; static build to be checked by CI after publication.

en.title: Global Macro — energy forecasts rise as Brazil approaches a new inflation test
en.deck: EIA raised Brent forecasts for 2026 and 2027; long Treasury yields eased after the 8 October auction, but Brazil's Friday IPCA and future energy pass-through remain unresolved.
en.regime: Persistent energy risk and high global financing costs coexist with a one-session decline in U.S. long bond yields; Brazil's September inflation reading is pending.
en.key_risk: Oil and refined-fuel costs spread into persistent broad inflation while financial conditions remain expensive.
watch: IBGE September IPCA breakdown on 9 October

pt-BR.title: Macro Global — previsões de energia sobem enquanto o Brasil se aproxima de novo teste inflacionário

pt-BR.regime: Risco energético persistente e financiamento global caro coexistem com recuo de um pregão nos juros longos americanos; o IPCA de setembro ainda não foi divulgado neste corte.
pt-BR.key_risk: Petróleo e combustíveis mais caros disseminam inflação persistente em ambiente de juros elevados.
